verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a unified Customer Area for managing payment terminals across a merchant's estate and a Management API for ordering terminals to specific delivery locations, which supports a hardware-fleet operating model. However there is no explicit documentation of per-location settings segmentation or per-location reporting/analytics breakdown as distinct configurable units — missing for 10: dedicated per-location settings/config docs, per-location reporting/dashboards, and independent confirmation of multi-location management at scale.
